_flip_comment: 1 mm facing allowance is step2cam judgement, additional to the existing 1 mm side-cut clearance. bottom_stock solves B >= max(min_grip_mm, min_grip_fraction*(part_height+top_stock+B)) + clearance + facing allowance. Rounded upward to 0.0001 mm for numerical safety, not a machining tolerance. Flip breakthrough 0.5 mm is judgement: opens the exit in sacrificial material without spending the full ordinary 1 mm on cutting-length reach.
_flip_contact_comment: Judgement: each jaw band needs at least 60% actual planar face area and 3.175 mm area/grip effective length. Each support footprint needs 75% horizontal face area and 3.175 mm area/width effective length. Search supports inward up to 16 mm in 0.25 mm steps; flip grip searches every fixed, inventory or cited standard height and chooses the deepest passing grip up to the existing 50% limit; a standard miss searches the prior computed grips with every contact/support check intact; reject interference by material below the flipped seat. Contact may bridge holes and edge breaks; these are area checks, not force calculations. Numerical frame tolerance 0.0002 mm covers compounded four-decimal frame serialization, not manufacturing tolerance.
